notes:
**Type instead of talking.** Can't talk out loud right now? Tap Win + Shift (press and let go), or the keyboard button on the island, type your message and press Enter. The answer shows on the island and nothing is said out loud. It's the same conversation as talking, so Hotaru can still open apps, play music and so on.

**Quiet mode.** Settings > General > Quiet mode: every answer is shown on the island instead of spoken, even when you talk to it.

Mac: the island now shows over full-screen apps too.
